title: builtinModules
responsibility: Admit included Code capabilities and external capability and testing plugins through one module schema.

outputs.name: builtinModules
outputs.description: builtinModules is the array of bundled capability definitions in this order: all of standardCodeModules, all of testingPlugins, then emailModule, offlineModule, rustWasmModule and rustBackendModule, each replaced by its moduleDefinitionSchema.parse result, which is the same admission contract project modules use. It is computed once at module evaluation, and a definition that fails parsing makes that evaluation throw, so importers never receive a partial array.

errors.name: moduleDefinitionSchema.parse error
errors.description: Thrown during module evaluation when moduleDefinitionSchema.parse throws for any entry in the bundled list, so the builtinModules export is never assigned. The file has no try/catch, so the error propagates to every module that imports builtinModules.
